description:
FloodLens is a public flood-awareness and satellite intelligence platform developed for Lahore, Pakistan, using NASA-ISRO NISAR Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) observations.
The platform processes satellite GeoTIFF imagery through a Python-based geospatial pipeline to identify and visualize candidate surface-change zones. Its current T084 analysis identifies 337 candidate polygons, classified into two categories: 21 near the Ravi River corridor and 316 associated with likely agricultural areas.
